title: WendOption
description: A single selectable row inside a wend-select's option panel.

value.description: Value submitted for this option when selected by its parent wend-select.

selected.description: Whether this option is the currently selected one. Set by the parent wend-select, not by the consumer directly.

active.description: Whether this option is the keyboard-active one (highlighted, not necessarily selected). Set by the parent wend-select.

disabled.description: Disables this option, excluding it from selection and keyboard navigation.

multi.description: Renders a decorative checkbox indicator on the left instead of the trailing checkmark icon on the right. Set by a multi-select coordinator (wend-combo-box), not by the consumer directly.
